skills.name: android-environment
skills.description: Locate the Gradle wrapper + JDK and enforce build hygiene: confirm the debug unit-test task exists, kill stale Gradle daemons, --no-daemon clean state. Triggers: 'set up the Android build', 'kill the stale Gradle daemon'.

skills.name: android-reproduce
skills.description: Android reproduce recipes: Logic = a failing host-JVM unit test (testDebugUnitTest), written first; UI (ASSIST) = build + code-level diagnosis only, never observed on a device. Internal: engine reproduce step.

skills.name: android-verify
skills.description: Android verify recipes mirroring reproduce: Logic = failing test passes + suite green; UI (ASSIST) = emit handoff/v0 with a UI LAYER_METHODS proof, ledger stops at candidate. Internal: engine verify step.

skills.name: android-source-map
